title: Ordinary étale inverse image preserves the scheme coefficient universe
statement: Let $S,T$ be schemes in universe $u$ [def-pc-scheme], $f:T\to S$ a morphism, and $G$ a sheaf of $u$-small sets on the small étale site of $S$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. Raise the values of $G$ to universe $u+1$ by $\operatorname{ULift}$ and apply the actual ordinary étale inverse-image construction [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. For every étale $T$-scheme $B$, the resulting section set over $B$ is $u$-small (equivalent to a type in universe $u$).

source.place: 03Q1(3) (lemma-stalk-pullback), 03PU (theorem-exactness-stalks), 03PT (stalks and sheafification); read https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03Q1, /03PU and /03PT. Lean proof uses the closed point, ULift, and Yoneda comparison declarations.

proof.text: For every geometric point s of T with separably closed field in universe u, identify the fibre of etaleSetPullback f with the fibre at s composed with f. Compose sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullbackIso, Point.sheafFiberComapIso and the proved source pointSmallEtaleComapIso. Point.sheafFiberCompIso for ULift identifies the fibre of a lifted Type u sheaf with ULift of its Type u fibre. Hence this fibre is u-small. These calculations are the private proved lemmas ulift_fiber_small and pullback_fiber_small.

Use the separable closure of the residue field at each point of T to get a u-small conservative family Ψ. Mathlib isConservativeFamilyOfPoints_pointSmallEtale' is its conservativity theorem. The proved source IsConservativeFamilyOfPoints.ulift raises the point universe to u+1 without enlarging the family. The source uliftSheafFiberIso identifies these lifted fibres with the original ones, so they remain u-small.

Let A be the lifted representable sheaf of B and H the inverse image in the statement. For every point in the family both the fibre of A and of H are u-small, by step 1 and the coefficient-lift comparison. The hom set between two such fibre sets is u-small. Joint faithfulness injects Hom(A,H) into the product of these hom sets over the u-small family. This product, hence Hom(A,H), is u-small. The sheaf uliftYonedaEquiv identifies Hom(A,H) with H(B), proving the conclusion. Subcanonicality is supplied by the closed source subcanonical_smallEtaleTopology instance.
